title: Current Action Architect Review Binding Authority
phaseTitle: Workflow Router Screen Correction and Guided Current Action UI
problem: WC08-REPAIR05 corrected the broad Architect Review workspace route, but the routed Architect Review form still binds to the wrong Work Card and wrong Implementer Report. The current action target is WC08-REPAIR04, but the screen binds to the reference card WC08-REPAIR05 and a stale parent WC08 Implementer Report.
goal: Make current-action state the authoritative binding source for routed Architect Review forms so WC08-REPAIR04 and its exact Implementer Report are selected regardless of reference-card selection.
userOutcome: The Operator can complete WC08-REPAIR05 validation because the app opens the Architect Review screen bound to the actual WC08-REPAIR04 target and associated Implementer Report.
scope: Create one typed routed-review binding contract derived once from current-action state and consumed by screen initialization, selector state, preview, and save.
Bind Architect Review screen from currentAction.workCardId and currentAction.sourceArtifacts.
Separate reference-card selection from routed current-action target authority using separate types/props so reference state cannot substitute for the routed target.
Auto-select WC08-REPAIR04 when the current action target is WC08-REPAIR04.
Prevent mismatched Work Card / Implementer Report combinations.
Preserve WC08-REPAIR04 route authority and route recovery behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The routed Architect Review screen binds to WC08-REPAIR04 when the current action target is WC08-REPAIR04.
The routed Architect Review screen displays or selects BUILDER_REPORT_WC08-REPAIR04_controlled_route_recovery_and_accurate_route_evidence_authority.md.
The routed Architect Review screen does not bind to WC08-REPAIR05 merely because that repair card is selected as a reference card.
The routed Architect Review screen does not bind to BUILDER_REPORT_WC08_current_step_context_inspector.md when the current action target is WC08-REPAIR04.
Reference-card selection remains available as reference/navigation context but does not override routed current-action authority.
Manual fallback selectors cannot silently create a mismatched Work Card / Implementer Report pair.
Architect Review preview output filename targets ARCHITECT_REVIEW_WC08-REPAIR04_controlled_route_recovery_and_accurate_route_evidence_authority.md.
Architect Review save output targets WC08-REPAIR04, not WC08-REPAIR05 and not parent WC08.
architect_review_of_implementer_report_required still routes to Architect Review, not Implementer Report Capture.
WC08-REPAIR05 compatibility diagnostics behavior remains intact.
WC09 remains blocked while WC08 repair-chain obligations remain unresolved.
A component-level integration test or equivalent mounted-renderer test exercises the real Architect Review state lifecycle with WC08-REPAIR04 as current action and WC08-REPAIR05 as reference context.
Focused fixture coverage exists for current-action binding overriding reference-card selection.
Focused fixture coverage exists for exact Implementer Report binding from current-action source artifacts.
validationPlan: Run approved normal Windows validation lanes.
Run TypeScript/type validation and production build validation.

Add a component-level integration test or equivalent mounted-renderer test proving reference-card selection cannot override the routed current-action Architect Review target through initialization and state updates; source-regex assertions alone are insufficient.
Add focused fixture coverage proving reference-card selection cannot override routed current-action Architect Review target.
Add focused fixture coverage proving WC08-REPAIR04 binds to its exact Implementer Report.
